headline: As of 2026-10-21: 16,989,125 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 45 of 50 states, D+15.4 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 16,989,125 early/mail ballots cast so far across 45 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+15.4 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (1,854,319), Florida (1,607,541), Texas (1,566,936).
